title: Splitting Algorithms Using Pairs Monotonicity to Solve the Sum of Two Non-monotone Operators Problem
summary: This paper is concerned with solving the problem of finding a zero of the sum of a single-valued operator and a set-valued operator, neither of which is assumed to be monotone, in a real Hilbert space. Under the framework of pair monotonicity, we propose a generalized forward--backward algorithm and a generalized Tseng algorithm based on transformed and warped resolvents associated with an auxiliary linear operator.
